data.change_summary: Refactored the substrate-zone update path so `step_substrate_zones` computes, applies, and returns a single `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown`, letting `engine.rs` reuse that result for tracing instead of recomputing the habitat registry and ROL breakdown twice. Also added the requested inline comment clarifying that `SubstrateSurface` includes the tank footprint top surface, so subtracting `footprint_area_cm2` isolates interstitial grain-matrix area before adding `SubstrateDeep` rootable area.
outstanding_risks: Validation was targeted rather than full-package: `cargo test -p tank_core` is still blocked by an unrelated existing compile error in `crates/tank_core/tests/denitrification.rs` where `rooted_plants` is undefined, so I validated the touched substrate/root-zone paths with narrower commands instead.
I did not run the full workspace test suite beyond the touched substrate/root-zone coverage.

steps.description: Inspect the substrate and engine call flow to confirm where `substrate_oxygenation_breakdown()` was being recomputed and identify the rootable-area subtraction site needing documentation.

Refactor `step_substrate_zones` to return the computed `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown`, add a shared zero-value helper for early exits, and update engine tracing to use that returned breakdown instead of triggering a second habitat-registry-backed computation.
Add the inline physical-meaning comment for the interstitial-area calculation, run formatting, and rerun targeted substrate/root-zone tests to verify the API change preserves behavior.
